concepts.def: Tiny bumps on tongue that taste

walkthroughs.body_html:
Smell molecules float into your nose and hit olfactory receptors.

Smell is the only sense that goes straight to the emotion and memory parts of the brain.

That's why old smells bring strong memories. 🌹

Your tongue has thousands of taste buds.

The five tastes: sweet, salty, sour, bitter, umami (savoury).

Most 'flavour' is actually smell — block your nose, food tastes bland. 🍫

The skin is your biggest organ. It has receptors for:

  • Pressure.
  • Heat and cold.
  • Pain.

Pain is your body shouting 'stop!' — it keeps you safe. 🛑
